data.text: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your steadfast love and faithfulness.
data.titulo: Give Glory to Your Name, LORD

data.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God now?”
Our God is in the heavens; he does all that he pleases.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
data.titulo: The Idols and Those Who Trust in Them

data.text: They have mouths but cannot speak, eyes but cannot see.
They have ears but cannot hear, noses but cannot smell.
They have hands but cannot feel, feet but cannot walk; they make no sound in their throats.
Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.
Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
data.titulo: Trust the LORD, Our Help and Shield

data.text: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
The LORD has remembered us; he will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
data.titulo: The LORD Remembers and Blesses His People

data.text: He will bless those who fear the LORD, small and great alike.
May the LORD increase you, you and your children.
May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but the earth he has given to the children of Adam.
data.titulo: The Living Bless the Maker of Heaven and Earth

data.text: The dead do not praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence.
But we will bless the LORD from now on and forever. Praise the LORD!
